jobs.occupation: Become a Wheel Loader or Forklift Operator for a Recycling Company – Environmentally Conscious Job i
jobs.description:
Are you skilled with a wheel loader or forklift and looking for a varied job in the recycling sector? This position as a wheel loader/forklift operator is perfect for you. You’ll help recycle plastic waste and contribute to a better environment. Your main tasks include moving plastic waste, handling big bags, and safely loading and unloading trucks.

On a typical workday, you’ll start with a short briefing before you begin moving waste streams around the site. You work accurately and ensure everything ends up in the right place. Sometimes the waste can have an odor, but thanks to your dedication, the site stays orderly and safe. You’ll follow a unique work schedule: 4 weeks working in Lanaken, followed by 4 weeks off at home in Poland.

Do you have a valid certificate and speak English or Polish? Apply now! You’ll receive a great salary, meal vouchers, and the possibility to extend your contract. We’re looking for motivated people who want to help build a more sustainable world.

• Possession of a forklift operator or wheel loader operator certificate

• Good command of English or Polish, both spoken and written

• Minimum diploma of higher secondary education

• Experience operating a wheel loader, forklift, or crane is a plus

• Flexibility to work in a 4-weeks-on, 4-weeks-off system

• Safety minded and orderly work habits

• Open to junior, medior, and senior candidates

Our client is a logistics trading company based in Breda.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you combine operational, commercial, and coordinating responsibilities within international ocean freight. You manage the full transport process from A to Z and act as the key link between internal teams and external partners. In addition, you lead a team and ensure structure, overview, and continuous process optimization.

The position is based in Breda, so you are willing to commute to this location on a daily basis.

Your Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate international deep-sea shipments (cross-trade)	
• Maintain contact and negotiate with shipping lines, forwarders, and suppliers	
• Book and follow up shipments until delivery	
• Manage and verify export documentation (B/Ls, L/Cs, Incoterms)	
• Analyze rates and optimize transport flows	
• Report to purchasing and sales teams	
• Lead and support a team (5 FTE)	
• Contribute to and implement improvements in operational processes

Your Profile
	
• 3 to 5 years of experience as a freight forwarder (deep sea), ready for the next step	
• Strong operational and commercial mindset	
• Experience with international transport within a trading environment is a plus	
• Good command of English (required); additional languages are an asset (Dutch not required)	
• Proactive, assertive, and strong communicator	
• Able to build relationships and identify opportunities	
• Strong organizational skills and sense of responsibility	
• Flexible mindset (willing to commute to Breda; international environment with multiple time zones)

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Join a Dynamic Team in Belgium!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you are key to ensuring our fleet runs smoothly. You carry out thorough diagnostics, repairs, and maintenance on DAF trucks. You view electrical issues as challenges and are comfortable reading electrical wiring diagrams. You test wiring harnesses, electrical systems, and control units, and communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about the work performed.

A typical day starts with a team meeting. Then, you work independently or with colleagues in our fully equipped workshop. You use the latest diagnostic equipment, keep up with the newest technical updates from the manufacturer, and coordinate with other mechanics when needed. Additionally, you provide technical support to our branch in Herent.

Are you looking for a technical role with variety, autonomy, and responsibility? Apply now and grow with our ambitious team!

• You have a high school diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent through experience.

• A professional or academic bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus.

• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector.

• Basic knowledge of electronics is required.

• You speak and understand Dutch fluently; knowledge of English is an asset.

• You are motivated, practical, and able to work independently.

• Leadership skills are a plus.

• A C(E) driver's license is an advantage but not required.
